title: Dispatch RFU 2: Soil in the Rising Water Comes from Elsewhere
summary: Samples contain earth from a hill forty miles away.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Inspector Daniel Voss caught the water as it rose through a fine gauze screen. The sediment left behind matches red soil from the abandoned quarry at Low Fell, where no rain has fallen for a week. A second sample contains salt and shells from Alderwick’s harbor.

Dr. Saye thinks the court has become an outlet for water gathered at other places in the Eidetic Stratum. The cloud above it has grown wider. Residents have been asked to move fragile belongings from the upper floors, although no water has fallen on them.
